title: Exact Split Strategies with Largest Remainder
instructions: Implement `split_equal`, `split_exact` and `split_percentage` in `splits.py` using only the standard library. Every split must return integer minor units that sum exactly to the total. Percentages use exact `Fraction` arithmetic and the largest remainder method, and `float` percentages are refused.

evidence.label: Equal split hands the remainder to the first users, one unit each
Equal split rejects non-positive or non-int totals and empty or duplicate users
Exact split requires positive int amounts that sum to the total
Percentage split uses largest remainder with ties broken by input order
Rejects float percentages (TypeError) and percentages not summing to 100
Shares always sum to the total and stay within one unit of the exact share
Preserves user order and does not return the caller's own dict
Handles a single user, rejects a 0% share and breaks ties by position
